digest.component_or_area: plan review criterion gating (T13, T14, removal-rationale, asserted-capability)
propositions: Four agentic criteria (T13, T14, removal-rationale, asserted-capability) have produced zero findings across 7,900+ runs and require deterministic pre-filters to avoid firing the LLM router on missing criterion vocabulary.

Deterministic gate rules must fire conservatively (skip only on total vocabulary absence) and preserve the LLM router as the sole applicability authority for fired plans, without reinstituting lexical applicability judgment.
Gate-skip decisions must be recorded in coverage.routing.det_gated alongside the routed criteria so every skip is visible in the REVIEW_RESULT sidecar.

The four criteria use overlapping and leaf-routed rule tables (DetGateRule objects with text_all conjunctions, file_impact_globs, and file_impact_reason_re) evaluated by updated overlay_triggers and a new leaf_gate_triggers path in route_criteria.
Asserted-capability fires only when both regex legs (module-ref and capability-verb) match, and T14 and removal-rationale fire on file_impact alone independent of plan text matching.
Existing T5a/T5d/T7/T12 overlay rules must migrate to DetGateRule objects and fire identically to their current regex strings on representative audit sentences.
